newsitem.title: USA: Fortune well fails to reach target.
newsitem.headline: Fortune well fails to reach target.

text.p: Fortune Petroleum Corp said Wednesday drilling operations on its Wynn No. 1 well in the South Lake Arthur Field, Jefferson Davis Parish, La., were suspended upon the determination that the well has crossed a fault and failed to reach the primary objective target.
The company said it believes the well may have encountered potential hydrocarbons in a shallower reservoir. However, the working interest partners do not currently own any rights to such reservoir.

The operator is in discussion with the owner of the shallow reservoir in an attempt to negotiate a mutually acceptable farmout of that reservoir. Fortune officials were not able to immediately identifiy the operator or other owners of the well.
If the farmout talks were unsuccessful, Fortune continued, it expects that the well would either be turned over to the owner of such reservoir or plugged and abandoned by the working interest owners.
Fortune said the cost of drilling and plugging and abandoning the well is estimated to be $380,000 to its 12.5 percent working interest. ((-- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.))
